text: Observed in the shared-expense-tracker pilot (e5dbe1f build): the planning worktree created by `now`/propose contains no node_modules, and resolveOpenSpecInstallation requires the exact project-local @fission-ai/openspec 1.6.0 install inside that worktree (root package.json pin, pnpm-lock importer pin, transitive closure, bin realpath inside root). The first resume after sealing therefore fails with OPENSPEC_INSTALLATION_INVALID and the agent must hand-provision the worktree. The engine should provision the worktree (or resolve OpenSpec from the main checkout) as part of change materialization.
